'''Near Pando''' was an emerging trade [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Near Pando system/Legends|Near Pando system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Pando Spur/Legends|Pando Spur]] that connected it to the world of [[Far Pando]]. Near Pando was the site of ancient and mysterious ruins known as the [[Malabar Construct]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Near Pando was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-14.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was also going to be mentioned in ''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: The Big Switch]]'', a young-readers book written by [[Ryder Windham]]; however, that book was postponed and eventually cancelled.<ref name="BigSwitch">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarstimeline.net/AdventuresinHyperspace.htm|text=Star Wars Adventures in Hyperspace Book 3 The Big Switch|author=van der Heijden, Eddie|date=2015-04-22|work=[http://www.starwarstimeline.net The Star Wars Expanded Universe Timeline]|archivedate=20161030010051}}</ref><ref name="Scholastic">{{Scholastic|domain=ca|url=booksellers/catalogues/fall2010/Fall2010_PB.pdf|text=Scholastic Paperback Books Fall 2010|date=2010-09}}</ref>

===''The Big Switch''===
{{Cutstart}}
Approximately [[4000 BBY/Legends|four thousand years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a portrait bust of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Bogga]] came to rest on Near Pando. Four [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, the bust was excavated from the ruins on the planet.<ref name="BigSwitch" />
{{Cutend}}
